paite: Paul, Silvanas leh Timothi in, Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist saptuam Thessalonika a omte kiang ah, Pathian i paleh Toupa Jesu Khrist a pan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Ka thumna uah na min uh lou in, nou tengteng ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen gige uhi.
heading: Thessalonikate Phathuaina

paite: I Pathian leh Pa ma ah ginna ziak a na thilhihdan uh leh itna ziak a na sepgimdante uh, Toupa Jesu Khrist lametna ziak a na kuhkalna uh mangngilh lou a, theigige in.
Unau Pathian ngaihtakte aw, nou ahon teldan ka thei uhi.

Ka tanchinhoih uh thu kia a na kiang uh hong tung lou in thilhihtheihna leh Kha Siangthou leh nakpi a theihchetna toh ahong tung zaw hi. Noumau makhua ngaihtuah in na tung uah bangchibang mi ka hita ua chih na thei uhi.
Huan thuhaksa thuak kawm in, Kha Siangthou a kipak in na pom ua, koumau leh Toupa zuite na hita uhi.
Huchi in Masidonia leh Akhaia gam a gingtu mi tengteng a ding in etton ding na hi uhi.
Toupa thu noumau a kipan in Masidonia leh Akhaia gam kia hilou, mun chih ah Pathian lam a na ginna uh athangkheta hi, kou bangmah ka gen uh akiphamoh nawn kei hi.
Amau mahmah in bangchibang vualzawlna toh na kiang ua ka hong lutdan uh ahon theisak uhi. Nou milimte a kipan a Pathian lam na hong ngat takdan uleh Pathian hing leh dik nasem ding leh,
van a kipan a Tapa, misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh, thangpaihna hong tung ding lak a kipan hon suaktasakpa, huai Jesu ngei na ngak ding in.
